prompt.project_info: Hyper-realistic smartphone portrait on a seaside resort deck at warm evening light.
prompt.main_subject: One generic approved adult blonde woman with long voluminous loose hair, narrow black sunglasses and natural unfiltered skin, reclining on a deck chair while holding a pink canned drink with straw and a magazine; wearing a white swimsuit with black inserts and white high-heeled shoes.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical 9:16 smartphone frame, subject on deck chair with sea and coastal houses behind, magazine and drink visible, subtle natural bokeh and evening resort depth.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Warm bright evening light with natural 5600K balance, realistic optical depth, slight sensor noise, no beauty filters, elite resort summer atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: High-end mobile CMOS look, f/1.8, realistic subsurface skin detail, visible pores and textile fibers, preserved microcontrast, no AI smoothing or post-processing.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a vertical 9:16 hyper-realistic smartphone photograph of one generic approved adult blonde woman reclining on a seaside deck chair, holding a pink canned drink with straw and a magazine, wearing a white swimsuit with black inserts, narrow black sunglasses and white high-heeled shoes; blue sea, rocky coast and hillside houses behind, warm evening light, authentic pores, textile detail, subtle natural bokeh and no beauty filters.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized pose, nudity, minors, celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, explicit body-part emphasis, distorted anatomy, extra fingers, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, logo overlay
